import sqlite3
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

conn = sqlite3.connect('dacomp-007.sqlite')
df = pd.read_sql_query("SELECT * FROM sheet1", conn)

print("
=== Validating Department-JobRole Roll-up ===")

# Calculate total monthly income by department
dept_totals = df.groupby('Department')['MonthlyIncome'].sum().reset_index()
dept_totals.columns = ['Department', 'Dept_Total_Income']

# Calculate total monthly income by department and job role
dept_job_totals = df.groupby(['Department', 'JobRole'])['MonthlyIncome'].sum().reset_index()
dept_job_totals.columns = ['Department', 'JobRole', 'Dept_Job_Total_Income']

# Sum job role totals within each department
job_sum_by_dept = dept_job_totals.groupby('Department')['Dept_Job_Total_Income'].sum().reset_index()
job_sum_by_dept.columns = ['Department', 'JobRole_Sum_Income']

# Compare department totals with sum of job role totals
comparison = pd.merge(dept_totals, job_sum_by_dept, on='Department')
comparison['Difference'] = comparison['Dept_Total_Income'] - comparison['JobRole_Sum_Income']
comparison['Match'] = comparison['Difference'].abs() < 0.01  # Allow for floating point errors
